SELECT -- 당해 회사 정보
ci.company_name, ci.registration_number, ci.representative_name, ci.company_phone, ci.address, ci.email, ci.created_at, -- 평가된 내용 td.teacher_id, td.document_type, td.status, td.uploaded_at, td.reviewed_at, td.file_path, -- 평가자 정보 a.full_name, a.email, a.phone FROM teacher_documents as td inner join company_info as ci
on td.teacher_id = ci.teacher_id LEFT JOIN admin as a
ON td.reviewer_id = a.admin_id
WHERE td.status='pending' AND td.uploaded_at BETWEEN #{stDate} AND #{edDat}

SELECT -- 당해 회사 정보
ci.company_name, ci.registration_number, ci.representative_name, ci.company_phone, ci.address, ci.email, ci.created_at, -- 평가된 내용 td.teacher_id, td.document_type, td.status, td.uploaded_at, td.reviewed_at, td.file_path, -- 평가자 정보 a.full_name, a.email, a.phone FROM teacher_documents as td inner join company_info as ci
on td.teacher_id = ci.teacher_id LEFT JOIN admin as a
ON td.reviewer_id = a.admin_id
where td.status !='pending'
